Contemporary type 1 diabetes pregnancy outcomes: impact of obesity and glycaemic control. OBJECTIVE To compare contemporary pregnancy outcomes in women with and without type 1 diabetes, and to examine the effects of obesity and glycaemic control on these outcomes. DESIGN AND SETTING Historical cohort study in a specialist diabetes and maternity network in Victoria. PARTICIPANTS All singleton births (at least 20 weeks' gestation), 2010-2013, were analysed: 107 pregnancies to women with type 1 diabetes and 27 075 pregnancies to women without diabetes. Women with type 2 diabetes or gestational diabetes were excluded. METHODS Data were extracted from the Birthing Outcomes System database; associations between type 1 diabetes and pregnancy outcomes were analysed by multivariable regression. MAI
